text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived with a snapped stem. Since it was delivered Monday, the 48-hour window for a damaged-on-arrival report has passed. Plant issues after that go through the Plant Care Guarantee, which covers 30 days from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members).

To file a claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. If approved, you'd get one free replacement of the same plant (store credit if it's out of stock), and you don't need to send the damaged plant back. I can't promise the outcome, since the specialist makes that decision.
